# Model { #ambdes.Model }

```python
Model(run_number, config)
```

Discrete-event simulation model for generating patient calls.

The model creates one call-generation process per patient category and
records generated patients during a single simulation run.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [generate_patients](#ambdes.Model.generate_patients) | Generate patients. |
| [request_ambulance](#ambdes.Model.request_ambulance) | Simulate ambulance response. |
| [run](#ambdes.Model.run) | Run the simulation model. |
| [warm_up](#ambdes.Model.warm_up) | Reset results collection after the warm-up period. |

### generate_patients { #ambdes.Model.generate_patients }

```python
Model.generate_patients()
```

Generate patients.

### request_ambulance { #ambdes.Model.request_ambulance }

```python
Model.request_ambulance(patient)
```

Simulate ambulance response.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type    | Description                             | Default    |
|---------|---------|-----------------------------------------|------------|
| patient | Patient | Patient requesting ambulance transport. | _required_ |

### run { #ambdes.Model.run }

```python
Model.run()
```

Run the simulation model.

Starts one patient-generation process for each category and runs the
simulation until the configured run length.

### warm_up { #ambdes.Model.warm_up }

```python
Model.warm_up()
```

Reset results collection after the warm-up period.
